sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 文本2轮＋完整属性附件（仅暂缺项除外）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: T1所用独立模型为M-INT-082（两条首层边柱不同材料的空间框架）。T1建立M-INT-082，按共通X梁受荷规则施加一层10、二层8kN/m²；T2二层面载改9kN/m²。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 不同楼层荷载及空间拓扑；材料分组的独立状态保持
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 最高层最右且Y最大梁柱节点Ux/Uz/Uy及最左首层柱底My/Rz；所有值附位置、方向、单位、工况及当前轮次；澄清前不编造数值。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 首层10保持；仅二层折算后梁载更新且不累加；空间柱网不变；面载只传X梁，Y梁不重复加载；两指定首层角柱材性保持，二层面载修改不能全局替换材料。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 按本题拟定 PKPM 独立重算并核验；逐轮状态与目标/非目标差异评测待实现
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 所有柱脚六自由度固定
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: X向6+6m、Y向5+5m，两层3.6m，一层10二层8kN/m²；楼面面载单向传给X梁，受荷宽度为相邻Y半跨之和；Y梁不重复承接面载；不设默认刚性楼板；关闭自重。
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 首层y=0面两角柱E=210000MPa，其余梁柱E=200000MPa，所有属性显式给定
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 一阶线弹性静力；自重关闭；不自动施加刚性楼板/刚域、默认附加载或自动规范组合；严格保留题定约束、材料/截面完整属性、局部轴、荷载坐标与长度基准；单位逐字段明确。 楼面面载仅按相邻Y半跨受荷宽度传给X梁，Y梁不重复加载；保留三维六自由度/轴力单元各自约束和题定局部轴；各轮只执行明确修改，未被修改的字段保持；澄清内容按该轮生效。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 软件指定题，必须实际调用PKPM完成每个可计算模型状态并取得当次结果；禁止用OpenSees结果冒充。仅显示设置/启动窗口不算完成；纯查询或单位变更可复用与未变模型一致的已验证结果。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 逐轮输入与澄清记录、模型状态快照及前后字段差异；变更目标与未变字段核对；原始求解输入/工程、软件版本/设置、运行ID和成功日志、原始结果到节点/构件/工况的映射；结果绑定当前模型状态。核对目标：最高层最右且Y最大梁柱节点Ux/Uz/Uy及最左首层柱底My/Rz。 保存PKPM原生工程及可复查模型导出/参数检查记录；模型改变后的新run须绑定更新后的工程，截屏只作辅助。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 首层两角柱与其余柱材料不同，现标准层复制拒绝跨层材料差异；仅X梁受荷规则也须补显式梁载映射；现接口对关闭自重、无刚性楼板及完整弹性/截面属性的逐字段映射未证明，须显式设置并核验，禁止静默采用软件默认。PKPM现结果接口缺节点反力；本题Rz要求保留，须补原生反力结果读取路径并独立校核，不能删除目标项或用OpenSees反力冒充。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 每个可计算轮次由独立复核者在PKPM创建参考模型并保存状态；模型改变后独立新算，纯结果查询沿用有效状态；核对力/矩平衡及适用解析结果，可用同假设OpenSees交叉校核；差异先追溯荷载分配/支座/轴向/楼板设置，不直接强求跨软件逐值相等。

turns.instruction:
Build and analyze the attached frame in PKPM. Story 1 pressure is 10 kN/m2 and story 2 pressure is 8 kN/m2. Only the two first-story corner columns on y=0, at x=0 and x=12 m, use E=210000 MPa; every other member uses E=200000 MPa. Report the specified responses.
Use the stated PKPM engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable run ID. Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Replace only the story 2 floor pressure by 9 kN/m2 downward and rerun PKPM. Recompute its X-beam line loads without accumulating the old loads. Keep story 1 at 10 kN/m2, preserve both special first-story column materials, all sections, supports and topology, and report current responses.

acceptanceGates.description: Execute the named engine independently for each changed computable state and each selection; retain software version, settings, native input, run ID, successful log and raw result mapping.
Generate and independently review same-engine reference values; check equilibrium, signs, units and stiffness without importing the SUT path.
Independently reconstruct each turn from only its released public input and verify original source requirements.
Verify target field changes, all non-target fields, undo equivalence and query-only state identity.
Exercise this case topology, loads, coordinates and selected engine; support in principle is not evidence of adapter acceptance.
Check signed quantities in the report body, locations, directions, units, selections and current turn against structured artifacts.
